summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose Week 52 results from Phase 3 VELA trials of sonelokimab in hidradenitis suppurativa. The filing provides clinical efficacy data (e.g., 67.2% HiSCR75, 33.1% HiSCR100) and patient-reported outcomes, with no transaction, M&A, or special-situation event. This is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
